title: Hussain tere lahoo ki
body:
hussain tere lahoo ki khushboo
falak ke daaman se aa rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khoon e nahaq chupega kyun kar
jise ye dunya chupa rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sabr tera teri ibadat
wo raah e haq mein teri shahadat
teri sadaqat ki daastanein
zamane bhar ko suna rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamam aalam ko ye dikhaya
kata ke gardan ko deen bachaya
magar ye ummat abhi bhi aale
nabi ko dekho sata rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghareeb maula ki bekasi pe
ghareeb maula ki bebasi pe
abhi talak wo zameen e karbal
lahoo se aansu baha rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan bete ki laash lene
chale hai maqtal ko shaah e waala
magar zaeefi qadam qadam par
utha rahi hai bitha rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
barehna sar hai ali ki beti
magar wohi azmat e mohamed
wo jis ki khaatir bhara hua ghar
luta ke karbal se aa rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaun hai jis ki guftagu mein
ali ka lehja jhalak raha hai
ye kaun hai jis ke walwalo mein
hussainiyat jag maga rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb hai ye karbala ka manzar
rawan hai sheh ke galay pe khanjar
zamana karwat badal raha hai
sakina aansu baha rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain maidan e karbala mein
ajeeb moti luta rahe hai
jawan bete bhatije bhai
ki laashein tanha utha rahe hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
